commands.label: sti-107-clean-checkout-v2
argv:
git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/firmdura/meta-firmdura-kirkstone.git /work/sample &&
git -C /work/sample checkout --detach 99a183a2aa10875a989c32a09dc5461b61ef731c &&
mkdir /work/verification &&
kas dump /work/sample/kas/baseline.yml > /work/verification/baseline-expanded.yml &&
kas shell /work/sample/kas/baseline.yml -c 'bitbake -p' &&
kas shell /work/sample/kas/baseline.yml -c 'bitbake -e libwebsockets' > /work/verification/libwebsockets.env &&
kas shell /work/sample/kas/baseline.yml -c 'bitbake -e firmdura-reference-image' > /work/verification/image.env &&
kas shell /work/sample/kas/baseline.yml -c 'bitbake -n firmdura-reference-image' &&
python3 - <<'CHECK'
import json, pathlib, subprocess
expected = {'sample': '99a183a2aa10875a989c32a09dc5461b61ef731c', 'poky': '93431249a6260da7bd29ee3ca32145d89e5b8259', 'meta-openembedded': 'ce8539c941f6fcbecaca4d16640ac105c0595589', 'meta-lts-collab': 'e127ed67e74ca6b7e0fdc6cbda572302886c00a0'}
actual = {}
for name, sha in expected.items():
    actual[name] = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', '/work/' + name, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
    if actual[name] != sha:
        raise SystemExit('Unexpected repository revision: ' + name)
    if subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', '/work/' + name, 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True).strip():
        raise SystemExit('Checkout is not clean: ' + name)
result = {'status': 'passed', 'repositories': actual, 'external_repository_cache_reused': False, 'download_or_sstate_cache_reused': False, 'scope': 'clean metadata/parse/dry-run only; no image built'}
pathlib.Path('/work/verification/repositories.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
CHECK
commands.cwd: sample checkout on the approved control host

resolved_observations.issue: The first VM restart stalled before SSH readiness.
resolved_observations.resolution: Stopped only the new instance and performed a bounded successful restart.

resolved_observations.issue: The unused writable host artifact mount did not mount.
resolved_observations.resolution: Removed it; verified source-only read-only mounts and successfully exported metadata through Docker copy.

resolved_observations.issue: kas initially lost the repository root due to Git ownership checks and filtered environment variables.
resolved_observations.resolution: Trust only /repo in each disposable container's Git configuration; do not change host Git settings.

resolved_observations.issue: The enabled ptest dependency graph lacked stunnel.
resolved_observations.resolution: Include meta-networking and its declared meta-python dependency at the existing immutable meta-openembedded pin.

resolved_observations.issue: A separate empty-volume ownership preparation did not suffice for the native clean-check container.
resolved_observations.resolution: Initialize ownership in the consuming container; validate the documented helper on another empty volume.

resolved_observations.issue: CMake and Ninja are absent from the pinned host image inventory.
resolved_observations.resolution: Do not install unneeded host packages; Yocto supplies native build dependencies. Record the actual required host tools.
